season_label_semantics.rule: Season label Y is the NCAA academic year Y-(Y+1) named in each page's season selector (for example '2016-17').

out_of_scope_policy.adjacent_2015_use: The bound 2015 discovery manifest may be read only as the E4 adjacent-season expectation source for 2016; it is never 2015 delivery.

manifest_binding_rule.select: the eligible manifest with the most captures
manifest_binding_rule.tie_break: the latest issued_at_utc, compared as parsed timezone-aware instants
manifest_binding_rule.identity_check: discovery_identity in the manifest must equal its directory name; a mismatch is REFUSED_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
manifest_binding_rule.partial_manifests: never eligible; listed as superseded with state PARTIAL
manifest_binding_rule.superseded_census: every other manifest of the season is listed with identity, state, capture count and its (team_season_id, raw_sha256) set relation to the bound manifest: SUBSET, EQUAL, SUPERSET, OVERLAP or DISJOINT
manifest_binding_rule.superseded_pair_absent_from_bound: every (team_season_id, raw_sha256) pair of a superseded manifest that is absent from the bound manifest is rehashed and its own page identity parsed: a page whose selected season equals the manifest season is a CONFLICT program-season cell; a page of another season or an unparseable page is an explicit CONFLICT row in the manifest census (with its page identity) and is never attributed to the manifest's season; nothing is dropped silently
manifest_binding_rule.raw_capture_rehash: every bound capture is rehashed from the lake; a hash mismatch is PAYLOAD_MISSING with no parse
manifest_binding_rule.unreferenced_raw_files: files under raw/SRC-015/ncaa_team_season_discovery referenced by no manifest are reported and never used as evidence

division_decoding.source_field: the division query parameter of the target team-season page's own ranking links

official_cross_check.agreement_required_for: the decoding proof over every overlapping program-season
official_cross_check.disagreement: CONFLICT (both official observations retained; neither overrides the other)

header_record_policy.source: the target team-season header record (W-L or W-L-T) only
header_record_policy.reconciliation: W+L(+T) must equal the completed contests derived from the page; a mismatch is an explicit cell, never silently fixed
header_record_policy.blank_or_zero_game_rows: retained as membership rows with record UNPLAYED_OR_BLANK; never dropped

transition_policy.rule: contemporaneous code observed on the team-season's own page; no projection from an adjacent season, CFBD or the current 2026 population
transition_policy.transition_flag: TRANSITION_OBSERVED for every program whose decoded code changes between consecutive delivered seasons, enumerated mechanically

season_2020_semantics.spring_contests: keep season_label 2020 with term SPRING; never relabelled 2021 or treated as missing
season_2020_semantics.non_playing_members: SOURCE_ABSENT graph cells; division from the official team-history row (E2) where present, else UNKNOWN_NOT_PROJECTED
season_2020_semantics.completeness: 2020 Division I completeness stays explicitly open

expected_population_sources.source: official team-history rows under raw/SRC-NCAA-OFFICIAL-STATS/ncaa_official_team_history (rows with 7 or more cells; blank-record rows kept)
expected_population_sources.role: expected keys and official division labels

expected_population_sources.source: season_options of bound captures in Y-1 and Y+1
expected_population_sources.role: graph-absent team-season detection; never projects a division
bracketing expectation for 2024-2025 keys present in 2023 and 2026; effective-dated, never projected

denominator_authority.aggregates: every numerator and denominator is recomputed from cells

program_season_grain.conference_official: only from the official team-history row; otherwise NOT_YET_AUDITED; CFBD conference is an observation
program_season_grain.external_program_season_table: code 2/3 program-seasons are retained in EXTERNAL_PROGRAM_SEASON for opponents; their Division I cell is NOT_APPLICABLE
program_season_grain.identity_resolution: CFBD/registry-keyed expectations bind to an NCAA org only through a unique registry resolution; otherwise IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED keyed by the provider identity; never by name only
program_season_grain.provider_key_binding: E3/E5/E6 provider keys bind to an NCAA organization only through reconciliation.participant_resolution; an unbound provider key is an IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED cell keyed by the provider identity and never counted in a Division I numerator
program_season_grain.payload_missing_org: a failed capture's organization comes from a bound adjacent-season page whose season selector names that team-season id, else from the opponent logo organization on rows that link it; otherwise the cell stays keyed by team-season id with organization unresolved

contest_grain.key: contest_key: 'ncaa:<contest_id>' from the schedule row's own /contests/<id>/box_score link in the document (a directory or caller hint never overrides it); a row without a contest link (Canceled, Ppd, scored-unlinked) is keyed 'nolink:<season>:<date>:<sorted participant keys>' and mirrored rows with the same key form one contest; a CFBD-only row is keyed 'cfbd:<game id>'
contest_grain.inclusion: exactly one row per contest with at least one participant whose program-season is code 11 or 12 or whose Division I membership is unresolved (flagged)
contest_grain.site: stated on the page's own schedule row: a leading '@' before the opponent means the page team is AWAY; a second line '@City, ST' (optionally followed by an event label) means NEUTRAL at that stated site; no marker means the page team is the listed HOME team; an event label without '@City' states no site. Game-grain site: NEUTRAL when any mirror states a neutral site; otherwise HOME/AWAY when the mirrors agree; otherwise UNKNOWN. Never from the caller or provider order.
contest_grain.non_competitive_rows: canceled, no-contest, forfeit and unscored contests are retained with their status and are never competitive
contest_grain.duplicate_observations: mirror observations live only in a separate observation table; orientations and duplicate routes never count as extra contests
contest_grain.orientations: exactly two rows per contest derived from the game row; an opponent outside Division I or a non-NCAA opponent gets an external-opponent view; a contest is never deleted
contest_grain.pair_coherence: team and opponent scores mirror; margins sum to zero; results complement
contest_grain.external_opponents: contests with a non-Division-I opponent or a plain-text (non-NCAA) opponent are retained; a plain-text opponent is an external identity keyed by its normalized display name
contest_grain.term: season 2020 rows dated on or after 2021-01-16 have term SPRING; every other row has term FALL; the season label never changes

cfbd_routes.fcs_route: ops/cycle30_work/raw/games bound by content sha256 recorded in ops/cycle30_work/outputs/CYCLE30_ACQUISITION_LEDGER.json (route /games, classification=fcs, year=Y)

reconciliation.forward_match: season, date within 1 day and the unordered pair of bound CFBD team ids; the exact oriented score when both sides are completed; site/neutral and non-neutral home orientation compared when the NCAA site is stated
reconciliation.reverse_match: every CFBD row with at least one Division I participant maps to exactly one NCAA contest or receives an explicit disposition

participant_resolution.identity_space: NCAA organization id <-> CFBD team id; the canonical registry ENTITY identity key TEAM|SRC-002|<id> supplies the canonical team id and its verified ALIAS rows
participant_resolution.name_candidates: the NCAA organization display name and the CFBD/registry names are normalized identically (BAT-554 normalization: unescape, NFKD-ASCII, lowercase, '&'->' and ', non-alphanumerics->space) with token expansions; a candidate is an exact normalized equality with a registry ALIAS (effective interval overlapping 2016-2025) or a CFBD game-row display name
participant_resolution.schedule_fingerprint: F[c] = number of the organization's completed, scored 2016-2023 page games in the CFBD-covered scope (at least one participant decoded code 11 or 12 that season) with date d, own points p and opponent points q, for which CFBD team c has a 2016-2023 game (either route) within 1 day of d with exactly p for c and q for its opponent; N = the number of those organization games in the CFBD-covered scope

rules.NAME_CONFIRMED_BY_SCHEDULE: exactly one name candidate c, F[c] >= 3, F[c] >= 0.5*N, and F[c] strictly greater than every other team's F
rules.NAME_COLLISION_DISAMBIGUATED_BY_SCHEDULE: several name candidates; exactly one candidate c has F[c] >= 3 and F[c] >= 0.5*N, every other candidate has F < 0.2*N, and F[c] is the strict maximum
rules.SCHEDULE_FINGERPRINT_ONLY: no name candidate: the best c has F[c] >= 5 and F[c] >= 0.8*N, and the runner-up has F <= 0.2*N
rules.otherwise: IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED (name-only, schedule-only below thresholds, name/schedule disagreement, or N = 0)
rules.one_to_one: a CFBD team bound to more than one organization, or an organization bound to more than one CFBD team, leaves every involved binding IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED

participant_resolution.evidence_years: only 2016-2023 CFBD rows are used as binding evidence; SRC-002 2024-2025 rows are never joined

reconciliation.disagreeing_field: CONFLICT with both observations retained; neither side is overwritten
reconciliation.schedule_cardinality: page rows equal contest rows involving the team-season equal its orientations; header W-L-T equals derived results; mismatches are explicit cells
reconciliation.single_bound_participant: a contest with exactly one bound participant (the other external or unbound) that matches exactly one CFBD game of that team within 1 day with the exact oriented score is CANDIDATE_ONLY with reason OPPONENT_IDENTITY_NOT_BOUND; never RECONCILED

subset_rules.FBS_ESTIMAND_SUBSET: parent contest rows whose both participants are code 11 in that season
subset_rules.FCS_SUBSET: parent contest rows with at least one participant of code 12 in that season
subset_rules.proof: bidirectional inclusion and no duplicates; a subset cannot add rows or define membership

output_identity_scheme.id: sha256 of the canonical JSON identity document {schema, stage, contract_sha256, producer, inputs, upstream, outputs: {relative path: sha256}}
output_identity_scheme.issued_at_utc: recorded in the run manifest; excluded from the identity document
output_identity_scheme.contract_sha256_embedding: every output file and run manifest embeds the contract sha256
output_identity_scheme.create_only: an existing id whose bytes equal the new content is verified and not rewritten; an existing id with different bytes is REFUSED_IMMUTABLE_COLLISION; nothing is rewritten in place
output_identity_scheme.contract_change: a different contract sha256 yields a new identity and a full rebuild into a new root
output_identity_scheme.validator_contract_check: the validator refuses a manifest whose embedded contract sha256 differs from the presented contract (CONTRACT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH)
output_identity_scheme.bulk_rows: remain in the lake; only small gate JSON is committed

forbidden_claims: a gate PASS for scope beyond 2016-2023 reconciliation

query_contract.module: aggie_analytics.national_population.query (standard library only: argparse, json, sqlite3)
query_contract.database_open: file:...?mode=ro URI; database manifest identity verified at open
query_contract.paging: --limit/--offset/--all with exact totals; a negative offset or unknown flag is refused

non_claims: no strength comparability or FCS translation
no scientific trust (UNTRUSTED_SHADOW and the closed trust gate remain)
no champion, A&M lift or Aggie Excess effect
no reuse or citation of Cycle30 proven_pit_training_rows=36 or kernel_trust_usable=true (AGENTS rule 8 discrepancy retained for BAT-700)

input_bindings.cfbd_fbs_route_2024_2025_scope: observation only (E5 expectation); no contest join

bat652_spine_membership.role: R38A01-04-D identity-level comparison only (observation); never authority or denominator

input_bindings.e4_adjacent_2015_rule: the 2015 manifest is bound by the same rule and read only for 2016 season_options adjacency

revision_note: V1.1 (before any materialization): the V1 participant-resolution sentence named SOURCE_MAPPING for CFBD ids, but the registry carries CFBD ids on team ENTITY identity keys (TEAM|SRC-002|<id>) and has no NCAA identities. V1.1 declares the identity binding (name candidates confirmed by each team's own schedule fingerprint, never name-only), the contest key for schedule rows without a contest link, the stated-site semantics and the 2020 term rule. Thresholds are fixed here before any binding or reconciliation result is computed.
